name: loom-storyboard
description: Build tooling for The Loom (loom/master-storyboard.jsx). Scoped to loom/ (the gallery has its own toolchain in gallery/). Bundles master-storyboard.jsx (+ its loom/src modules) into loom/dist/ via esbuild; /loom serves that pre-built bundle (the in-browser Babel path was retired).
